svg.data-weight: 24.5 kg (54 lb) with two AC supplies, two blanks and three fan modules fitted; 24.3 kg (53.6 lb) for the DC build (Table 30)
svg.data-mounting: four-post rack kit in the box; spare kits EX4500-4PST-RMK
svg.data-throughput: 2.88 Tbps and 1 Bpps of forwarding capacity (Q5 ASICs); 144 x 10 GbE, 36 x 40 GbE or 12 x 100 GbE ports (Table 2)
svg.data-packet-buffer: deep buffer from hybrid memory cubes (HMC)
svg.data-psu-ac-input: 100 to 127 VAC and 200 to 240 VAC at 50 to 60 Hz, 9.5 A at 100-120 VAC (Table 21); each supply has one input
svg.data-psu-dc-input: -48 to -60 VDC rated, -40 to -72 VDC operating range, 40 A maximum; a 40 A breaker is recommended
svg.data-psu-redundancy: four bays, 2N recommended; one supply runs the 36Q at 110 VAC or 220 VAC
svg.data-heat-dissipation: 1,911 BTU/hr typical and 2,730 BTU/hr maximum (Tables 21 and 25)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 C to 40 C (32 F to 104 F)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 C to 70 C (-40 F to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing; short term 5 to 93 percent
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1828.8 m (6000 ft)
svg.data-storage: two 25 GB SSDs (the hardware inventory text also names a 25 GB NAND flash drive)
svg.data-asic: Q5 packet forwarding ASICs with hybrid memory cubes
svg.data-timing: 1PPS and 10 MHz SMB connectors and a PTP Ethernet SFP port
svg.data-seismic: Designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements per NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 3
